user_query: What time does the last weekday Red Line campus shuttle leave the medical campus in the winter timetable?

retrieved_docs.text: Winter shuttle timetable — Red Line last weekday departure from the medical campus is 22:15. Saturday service ends at 20:00. Real-time tracking is on the Transit app. Cancellations are posted on the Transit app, not via assistants.
